---
title: "Reflections on summer"
date: "2026-08-26"
---

Summer break is coming to a close. My to-do list is expanding. All I want to do is go for a long walk outside.

It's been a very fortunate summer for me in all seriousness. 
I advised on my first "official" undergraduate research. 
I've made connections at conferences and in my local community. 

I'm feeling excited about delving into immunology research this fall. 
I'm also feeling nervous to teach a topics course on a subject I'm quite new to. 

It's a time of growth, and that presents it's own difficulties. 
But such is life. 
We shall persist.
